units.source_text: 源氏公子来到嵯峨佛堂。

en.t: Prince Genji came to the Buddhist hall at Saga.

units.source_text: 他规定，这里的佛事，每月十四日普贤讲，十五日阿弥陀讲，月底释迦讲。

en.t: He prescribed the services to be held there: a Samantabhadra lecture on the fourteenth of each month, an Amitabha lecture on the fifteenth, and a Shakyamuni lecture at the end of the month.
These were only proper arrangements and need no further mention.

units.source_text: 此外他又增加了其他种种佛事。

en.t: In addition, he added many other Buddhist services.

units.source_text: 关于佛堂装饰及各种法器，亦各有指示。

en.t: He also gave detailed instructions about the decoration of the hall and the various ritual implements.

units.source_text: 到了月色当空之时，才从佛堂回大堰邸。

en.t: Only when the moon was high in the sky did he return from the hall to the Oi residence.

units.source_text: 此时他想起了当年明石浦上月夜的情景。

en.t: At that moment he remembered the moonlit scene long ago on the shore at Akashi.

units.source_text: 明石姬猜到他的心事，便乘机取出那张纪念品的琴来，放在他面前。

en.t: The Lady of Akashi guessed what was on his mind, and taking the opportunity, brought out the koto kept as a keepsake and placed it before him.

units.source_text: 这时源氏公子心中无端地顿感凄怆，难于忍受，便弹奏一曲。

en.t: Then Prince Genji was suddenly overcome by an unaccountable sadness that he could hardly bear, and he played a piece.

units.source_text: 琴弦的调子还同从前一样，并无改变。

en.t: The tuning of the strings was still just as it had been before, unchanged.

units.source_text: 因此弹奏之时，从前的情景仿佛就在目前。

en.t: And so, as he played, the scenes of the past seemed to stand before his eyes.
Then the prince recited a poem:
